name: Delish & Bake — Executive Analytics Dashboard
description: Executive Business Intelligence dashboard for Delish & Bake Order Management: GMV, sales channels, KDS turnaround, OCC concurrency, and refund ledger audit.

collection.name: Delish Bakery Operations
collection.description: Real-time analytics connected to Supabase PostgreSQL

native.query: SELECT date_trunc('day', o.created_at) AS order_date, o.method AS channel, SUM(o.total) AS revenue_jd FROM public.orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

cards.name: أفضل منتجات المخبز مبيعاً (Top Bakery Items)

native.query: SELECT COALESCE(p.name_ar, oi.name_ar) AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS sales_jd FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales_jd DESC LIMIT 10;

cards.name: حالة خط الإنتاج بالمطبخ (KDS Live Pipeline)

native.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM public.orders WHERE status IN ('new', 'confirmed', 'baking', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery') GROUP BY 1;
SELECT order_number, customer_name, total AS total_jd, deposit_paid AS paid_jd, (deposit_paid - total) AS refund_due_jd FROM public.orders WHERE deposit_paid > total ORDER BY created_at DESC;
SELECT CASE WHEN version = 1 THEN '1x' WHEN version BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3x' ELSE '4x+' END AS version_group, COUNT(*) AS count FROM public.orders GROUP BY 1;
